## Change type

- [ ] Project code or documentation
- [ ] New Agent/Skill artifact
- [ ] New version of an existing artifact
- [ ] Withdrawal or correction request

## Summary and linked issue

Describe the change and link any related issue. Do not include private task text, model outputs, credentials, or personal data.

## Artifact provenance (complete for Agent/Skill submissions)

- Artifact ID and version:
- Original source URL and fixed commit/release:
- Author or rights holder; your authority to submit and redistribute:
- One declared license for the complete package: MIT / Apache-2.0
- Exact root license file included in `support_files`:
- Upstream NOTICE present? Yes / No / Unknown. Give the upstream path checked and include every applicable NOTICE file in `support_files`:
- Apache-2.0 changes to upstream files, with prominent changed-file notices:
- Complete file inventory and SHA-256 hashes (include scripts, references, assets, license and NOTICE):
- Required tools, network access, credentials, permissions and user data:
- Task types where this is useful, and cases where it should not be recommended:

## Review state (maintainers only)

- Status: pending / needs information / rejected / locally admitted / paused / withdrawn
- Reviewer, exact package hash and evidence reference:
- Source, rights, license, NOTICE, content and permissions checked:
- Routing scope and reason, if separately enabled:

Submitting a PR does not grant automatic admission, distribution, a quality score, points, or a rollout. Maintainers review the exact package and record the decision. Changes require a new version and a fresh review.
